description: New property on Airbnb. Exceptional, fully air-conditioned 150m2 apartment for up to 11 guests, located in the sought-after Marais district.This rare gem offers a unique living space with its private garden.The Living Room: A large folding glass wall opens the living space entirely onto the garden, creating a seamless flow between indoors and out.Bedrooms: Each bedroom opens directly onto the garden.Private Garden of 65m2 : Set in a rear courtyard, it enjoys absolute peace and quiet.The spaceThe apartment150m² fully renovated in a resolutely high-end spirit: fine materials, meticulous finishes, and full air conditioning, a rare comfort in Paris. The cathedral-style living room is the beating heart of the home. Flooded with light, with its 4.4m ceilings and its large folding glass wall, it dissolves the line between inside and out: slide the wall open, and the lounge flows straight into the garden.The private garden60m² of greenery, entirely yours, tucked into a rear courtyard, sheltered from noise and prying eyes. A true Parisian luxury: your own outdoor space for morning coffee, sunset drinks, or dinner under the open sky.The bedrooms4 spacious bedrooms, each opening onto the garden, sleeping up to 11 guests, perfect for families and groups of friends alike. Two full bathrooms, plus a dedicated workspace for anyone working remotely.The neighborhoodRue de Turenne, one of the finest addresses in the Haut Marais. On foot: Place des Vosges, the Picasso Museum, the historic Marché des Enfants Rouges food market, art galleries, designer boutiques, and the Marais’s best tables. You’re right at the center of historic Paris, while enjoying a pocket of calm.Who it’s forFamilies, groups of friends, or discerning travelers looking for an exceptional home base in the heart of old P
